throughLine.title: Every system here moves something to someone who needed it.
throughLine.body: Study partners to students working alone. Live power readings to households. Branch news to members. The problems differ. The shape of the answer rarely does.

manifesto.flowBody: Get the shape right and the system runs without you. Most of my work is invisible by design. You notice it only when something breaks.
manifesto.systemsBody: I do not build screens. I build what sits behind them. 100+ endpoints, 100+ realtime events, 20 data models, and the tests to keep them honest.
manifesto.connectionBody: Every project here started because someone could not reach something on their own. StudyNest reached students studying alone. EnerGrid reached households paying for power they never see.

about.intro: I'm a Software Engineering graduate (BSc, First-Class Distinction) from Al Buraimi University College with a 3.96/4.00 CGPA, more interested in shipping working systems than collecting frameworks. My capstone, StudyNest, took me from a problem statement to a deployed, AI-powered platform used by real students, and to the national STEM finals.
about.focus: I focus on full-stack development, low-latency real-time applications, and practical AI integration. I like work that is precise, fast, and accountable to real users.
